RateAFlorist Edison florist directory (addresses, phones, hours)
Chamkila Express site (Legacy Hall venue page and contact page)
NJ MVC licensed driving school roster (PDF)

Own websites consulted for pet, sign, print, lab and music businesses (pawsticcerie.com, doggie-dazzle.com, bellsignsnj.com, decalsbydesign.net, e-consortium.com, aelgroup.net, musicforevernj.com, iansbridal.com)
Web search across Edison category queries (florists, venues, sign shops, printing, childcare, hotels, labs, pet)

categories_thin: Independent hotels: Edison lodging is almost entirely branded (Sheraton, Hilton Garden Inn, Courtyard, Extended Stay); only E Hotel plus two small Route 1 motels (Beauty Rest, Lee's) surfaced, and one motel site is in a municipal redevelopment area.
Labs and testing: only DDL NJ (national firm) and Affiliated MRD (small independent) surfaced; other Edison labs appear to be branches of national firms.

Childcare: dominated by national franchises (Tutor Time, Primrose, Lightbridge, The Learning Experience, Big Blue Marble, Kumon), leaving few independents; several licensed Edison centers could not be tied to a non-franchise operator.
Art, dance and music schools: many exist but most publish only a phone or a web form and no street address, so several entries still have address 'Unknown'.

Printing and signs: heavily franchised (FASTSIGNS, Minuteman Press, EmbroidMe, AlphaGraphics); five independents found (A2Z, Bell, Decals by Design, Peter's, Consortium) but directory detail for Peter's and Bell could only be read through search renderings.
Pet retail: PetSmart/Petco dominate; independents here are grooming, boarding, sitting and mobile grooming only.
caveats: Removed in this revision as unsupported, closed or out of zone: Saree Bazar (1384 Oak Tree Rd is in Iselin/Woodbridge, not Edison); Oak Tree Jewelers (a YellowPages listing marks it closed and the sole source was unverifiable); Lou Rose Music Center (reported closed, and its domain does not resolve - its phone is now carried by Music Forever); Villa Gennaro (primarily a restaurant selling per-person event packages, an excluded food type); Little Treasures Learning Center (New Jersey's licensed child-care list shows Big Blue Marble Academy - an excluded chain - at 2177 Oak Tree Rd Ste 100).

Excluded as chains or franchises: Joyalukkas, Kalyan Jewellers, Tanishq, Raj Jewels, Virani, Kay, Zales, Sylvan, Mathnasium, C2 Education, JEI, Kumon, Genie Academy, Tutor Time, Primrose, Lightbridge, The Learning Experience, Big Blue Marble, Trek/Electra, FASTSIGNS, Minuteman Press, EmbroidMe, Color Me Mine, Barnes & Noble, Menlo Park Mall national tenants, Graham Packaging, Imperial Dade, Storopack, Cembre USA.
Excluded large multinationals with Edison sites: LyondellBasell, William Grant & Sons, Katoen Natie, Zebra Pen, Teva.
Oak Tree Road straddles the Edison/Iselin (Woodbridge) line; several jewelry, clothing, florist and appliance shops listed there may sit in Iselin. Township should be confirmed before outreach.

Low-confidence block: roughly 35 manufacturing, wholesale and chamber-only entries rest on a single chamber or bulk-directory listing with no independent confirmation that the company still occupies the Edison site. Each such entry now says so in active_evidence and notes; Lawler (7 Kilmer Ct), Jende (5 Ginesi Ct), Custom Craft Plastics (100 King Arthurs Ct) and Transglobal (59 Winthrop Rd) are the most home-office-looking addresses. Verify individually before outreach.

Privacy care: Bengal Looms (residential street, online seller) has its street address withheld; Hall of Fame Grooming Salon's only listed address appears to be a residential parcel, so no address or phone is published here.

Chamkila Legacy Hall shares an Oak Tree Rd address with the operator's dhaba; it is included because the venue is marketed as a separately bookable banquet hall, and triage should confirm the operating entity.
Chamber-only and bulk-directory entries are listed rather than dropped, because the brief asks for completeness; the triage team confirms them.
data_gaps: YellowPages.com, AllPages.com, Superpages, Cylex and AllBiz mostly returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches, so their Edison category lists could only be read through search-engine renderings, not opened page by page.
OpenStreetMap/Overpass was not usable from this environment, so no map-based cross-check of the address list.
Google Maps/Bing Maps place data could not be paginated stably; per-business review counts are missing for most entries.

Several school and studio sites render their addresses in scripts or images rather than text, so Yvonne's School of Dance, Studio M, Worldwide Music School, PALS, AE2, Dr Lopez, Nartan Fusion and AC Tanjore Arts still have no verified street address.

Vivek Flowers could not be confirmed in Edison: its store-locations page failed to load and it is absent from the florist directory that covers Edison; the verifier's address (1734 Oak Tree Rd Unit 6) is recorded as unverified.
P.M. Studios address conflict (40 Bloomfield Ave vs 1021 Amboy Ave) is unresolved; both listings share the same phone.
Ian's Bridal Shop address conflict (226 US Route 1 on its own site vs 712 US Hwy 1 in a directory) is unresolved.
bellsignsnj.com, peterssignsllc.com and e-consortium.com/contact-us did not return readable content, so Bell Signs, Peter's Signs and Consortium details rest on directory/search renderings.
DDL NJ, Hotpack Global and the NJ Convention & Exposition Center may exceed the 500-staff cap; included and flagged for triage.
Big Blue Marble Academy now occupies the former Little Treasures site; no current independent operator was found for that address.
